notes: Uses verified album artwork consistently in recent albums, featured albums, album grid and list views, album detail, track listings, and newly added playlist tracks.
Album tracks inherit their album cover by default; track-specific artwork can override it when verified.
Crazy Covers now support verified per-track artwork without substituting decorative or guessed images.
Albums that have not yet been enriched continue to use neutral MusicVerse placeholders rather than incorrect cover art.
